message: Update version to 0.9.0.
Support searching by CN/KR title and by artist.
Update playdata import flow to work around iOS limitations. Make modal pages respect safe areas.
Support exporting playdata to taiko-rating-analyzer format.
Support parsing and importing of fumen-database playdata through a bookmarklet.
Create a local persistent user profile and use it to store tester mode status.
Add a settings modal page, move the developer mode toggle there.
Update version to 0.8.6.
Update dev server to use port 8082.
Add basic branch stats display.
Delay the display of loading text until 1s since page load.
Use port 8081 for playwright tests to avoid conflict with dev/start.
Use heroicon for the horizontal controls toggle.
Update README.
Reduce code duplication in renderer implementation.
Fix broken test cases.
Update version to 0.8.5.
Add missing attribution text under renderChart.
Fix file sharing web fallback.
Move the save image button and full screen button to a shared chart options footer.
Disable PWA service worker in development mode.
Remove canvas container padding and use renderer insets instead. Fix minor issues regarding insets in the renderer.
Add basic partial rendering functionality. Add toggle to render only the selected notes.
Run formatter.
Add limited horizontal compression to chart title if too long.
Update version to 0.8.4.
Fix PWA offline support on iOS: use absolute paths, inline Workbox runtime, and add conditional debug info.
Update outdated test snapshots.
Fix linking of the Neutralino runtime library which was broken since the migration to vite.
Add app version and platform label to about modal.
Add a minimal attribution label to the end of rendered chart.
Run formatter.
Update line wrapping behavior to avoid horizontal scroll in chart list.
Add a minimal loading screen until UI initialization completes.
Update version to 0.8.3.
Update icon for the "exit fullscreen" button.
Attempt to fix occasional unresponsive scrolling of fullscreen chart.
Improve chart rendering DPR fallback for large render sizes.
Update version to 0.8.2.
Update chart rendering with more consistent and configurable insets/paddings.
Run formatter.
Dynamically change minimum note diameter during auto zoom calculation.
Add DPR parameter in renderer package API, and clarify the showAllBranches behavior.
Fix blank screen on load by preventing unnecessary Neutralino init, add offline UI test.
Update version to 0.8.1.
Add a dev mode toggle and move some UI to a tester tab. Add a zoom stats debug label.
Fix Tester Panel example button state management.
Add custom style for language selector.
Use heroicon for modal close button.
Apply formatter to song_mapping JSON.
Add quick, simple animations to panels, chart and modal.
Update version to 0.8.0.
Update song mapping generator to support incremental updates. Check in the mapping file.
Minor formatting fixes.
Update song mapping generator to make use of TaikoWiki database. Refine LLM prompt and output format.
Fix directory export button visibility and functionality.
Add basic offline and auto update support to the PWA (not including ESE).
Migrate build process to vite.
Add spacing between header and chart when the header wraps.
Add basic PWA support, making the web app installable and removing browser UI.
Update version to 0.7.8.
Wrap chart difficulty and BPM headers if title or subtitle is too long.
Avoid text input auto zooming and autocoreect on iOS.
Remove .tmp files.
Replace shell build scripts with cross-platform Node.js script.
Support fullscreen mode in more browsers. Add a floating close button in fullscreen mode.
Update version to 0.7.7.
Add basic chart fullscreen support.
Minor style fixes for hover color and status panel.
Update formatter config and run formatter.
Polish auto-zoom logic: use weighted efficiency score for varied bar lengths.
Update version to 0.7.6.
Replace collapse/expand buttons with heroicons and clickable panel headers.
Fix blocked font request warnings by removing explicit font names.
Clean up some redundant comments.
Update the changelog panel to also display ESE version and a link to file issues.
Run formatter.
Get commit hash and date when fetching from ESE.
Fix macOS portable app icon issue by converting PNG to ICNS in build script.
Update version to 0.7.5.
Add release script to automate Neutralino builds and GitHub releases
Add auto zooming functionality which adjusts zoom level based on canvas width.
Add portable builds using neutralino-build-scripts via setup script and patch.
Update version to 0.7.4.
Fix build errors in fresh clone: update package config and tsconfig.
Update README.
Update vertical beat divider line width to match bar border width.
Reduce bottom spacing of floating chart options tab in vertical layout.
Update version to 0.7.3.
Add a script to generate song mapping into ESE paths.
Fix some formatting issues.
Fix a test case that never completes.
Remove the horizontal midline in rendered chart. Added vertical lines for every quarter beat.
Add minimal renderer usage example.
Implement high-level API in renderer package
Extract core renderer logic to renderer-package.
Fix Neutralino native functionalities, especially chart export to directory.
Attempt to address a flaky test case.
Update version to 0.7.2.
Improve long note rendering and selection logic.
